reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
), windowed AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT channel_id, spend_date, spend_eur,
    SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / 7.0 AS avg_7d
  FROM daily
)
SELECT channel_id, spend_date, spend_eur, ROUND(avg_7d, 2) AS avg_spend_7d
FROM windowed
WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-08-31'

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-08-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
), w AS (
  SELECT channel_id, spend_date, spend_eur,
    SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s7
  FROM daily
)
SELECT channel_id, spend_date, spend_eur, ROUND(s7 / 7.0, 2) AS avg_spend_7d
FROM w
WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-08-31'
